spec.vuln_cue: mentions their anxiety has been really bad lately

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Morag Quigley. I’ve been charged unarranged overdraft fees and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into that. Before we discuss the account, can you confirm your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I can see fees of £60 on 3rd October. What’s the issue?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I went over by a few pounds, and those fees have made things worse. My anxiety’s been really bad lately and this is stressing me out.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. I’m logging this as a complaint. I can refer you to our Financial Support team, or note that you may need extra time to respond to us.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Could you refer me to them, please? I want someone to look at the fees as well.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. I’ll send the referral today. I can’t say what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll own the complaint and review the fees. I’ll contact you by phone by 31st October with an update, and the Financial Support team will contact you about support.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get the final answer?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response within 8 weeks of today. That’s the process.
